summary: Upexi, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a private placement under a Securities Purchase Agreement with an existing institutional accredited investor. The company issued 5,250,000 common shares at $1.59652/share and pre-funded warrants for 6,992,300 shares at $1.59631/warrant, for aggregate proceeds of $19,542,634.54, satisfied by retiring an equivalent amount of principal under the holder's existing Secured Convertible Note. No placement agent was engaged. The post-closing note balance is $16,419,340.46, with conversion price unaffected and a 9.99% beneficial ownership limit. This is a routine debt-to-equity conversion and private placement, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution and note terms.
